title: 2. Munch-Munch Fruit (Baku Baku no Mi)
facts: Fruit look from the user's oparchive screenshots (refs/batch3/DESIGNS.md)

plan.fruit: Drawn from the design you sent (refs/batch3).

lines.text: You take a bite#red of a weird zigzag purple#purple fruit.
lines.say: You take a bite of a weird zigzag purple fruit.

lines.text: Don't panic,#red that's just a Devil#purple Fruit.#purple
lines.say: Don't panic, that's just a Devil Fruit.

lines.text: Out of every fruit in the sea,#blue
lines.say: Out of every fruit in the sea,

lines.text: a Paramecia#orange that lets you eat anything,#green even metal and stone.
lines.say: a Paramecia that lets you eat anything, even metal and stone.

lines.text: First, your mouth opens huge and you chomp through#purple cannons#gold and walls.
lines.say: First, your mouth opens huge and you chomp through cannons and walls.

lines.text: Then whatever#gold you eat becomes#green part of your body, so you can turn your arm into a cannon.
lines.say: Then whatever you eat becomes part of your body, so you can turn your arm into a cannon.

lines.text: You can even eat your own crew and fuse into one weird#pink soldier.#orange
lines.say: You can even eat your own crew and fuse into one weird soldier.

lines.text: Your strongest#blue trick is Munch-Munch#orange Factory: you eat a whole house and become one.
lines.say: Your strongest trick is Munch-Munch Factory: you eat a whole house and become one.

lines.text: The user ran away from his own island#green when pirates#orange showed up.
lines.say: The user ran away from his own island when pirates showed up.

lines.text: Wapol, the old king of Drum Island,#green got blasted#orange into the sky by Luffy.
lines.say: Wapol, the old king of Drum Island, got blasted into the sky by Luffy.

lines.text: Users of this fruit never do the dishes.#orange
lines.say: Users of this fruit never do the dishes.

lines.text: Which fruit#pink do you want next?#gold Follow for more.
lines.say: Which fruit do you want next? Follow for more.
